title: Choose the visual world for Lahzah
question: The roll assigned Sanad. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Sanad
options.lineage: The ijazah certificate and the sanad — the named chain of transmission a reciter earns
options.thesis: Practice as an unbroken chain of attestation, never a score.
options.viewport: Today's leaf in an open register: the date ruled across the head, the day's ayah set as the text block, and the chain of prior days descending the left margin as linked seals.
options.risk: Slides into faux-parchment costume the moment the paper is aged warm instead of kept cool and modern.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.lineage: botanical folio, one plant across five fixed-scale plates
options.thesis: A verse's memorization shown as registered stages at one unchanging scale.
options.case: Fuses well for Hifz — dormant, emerging, secure read as real SRS states — but cream ground and engraved italic fight the locked Syne/Inter/DM Mono, and the world belongs to Western scientific illustration, not this reader's own.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.lineage: a silk cape whose hidden cord pulls a flat plane into ribs and volume
options.thesis: One control gathers a flat page into structure.
options.case: The single-cord transformation maps neatly onto the reader's translation, transliteration, and word-by-word toggles gathering the page — but couture is not an object this audience knows by heart, so it loses audience identification.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.lineage: carbon rods and red cord held apart by opposing force
options.thesis: A practice that stands by balanced tension, not by effort.
options.case: Fuses poorly: force diagrams clarify load paths, not reading position or prayer times, and the engineering register runs cold against scripture. Its breathing motion is worth stealing regardless.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Emerald and gold, arabesque lattice, mosque silhouette at dusk, a stack of Today cards.
canonCard.viewport: What every Quran app on the App Store ships, executed at the craft level of the best of them.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Muslim Pro and Quran.com on a home screen.
